{{Quote|You made me an offer I couldn't refuse.|Sahr explains why she gave the tip on the ''Kizbon's Box'' to Larken|<ref name="ABGTAS" />}}
'''Sahr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]], [[Color/Legends|Blonde]]&ndash;[[Hair/Legends|haired]] individual who worked with the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Larken]] on board his [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Pillage]]'' as a gunner. Sahr became Larken's partner and gunner after she sold him a tip as to the location of the [[Helix-class light interceptor|''Helix''–class light interceptor]], ''[[Kizbon's Box]]''. With this information Larken and Sahr, along with two other pirate vessels named ''[[Trust Me]]'' and [[Profit (pirate ship)|''Profit'']], the latter of which was [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by an individual named [[Druug]], [[Ambush near Darknon Station|attempted to capture]] the ''Box''. The group positioned themselves near the [[Space station/Legends|space station]], [[Darknon Station]] under the cover of a [[Ion storm/Legends|magnetic storm]] in preparation to ambush their target. When the ''Box'' arrived the three ships moved in on the supposedly unarmed target but were horrified to find their mark had several hidden armaments including [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedos]]. With the torpedoes it destroyed ''Trust Me'' and ''Profit'' before it's [[Unidentified pilot (Kizbon's Box)|owner]] [[Comlink/Legends|commed]] Larken and Sahr in the ''Pillage'', addressing them both by name. Whilst acting as Larken's gunner Sahr wore a [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Clothing/Legends|blouse]] and black pants. She was short and lithe of stature and smiled pleasantly when Larken spoke to her.<ref name="ABGTAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sahr first appeared in [[1995]] the article "[[A Buyer's Guide to Alternative Starships]]" which was published in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 5|fifth]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' series of supplement books for [[West End Games]], ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The article was written by [[Stephen Luminati]] and included two short stories to illustrate some of the ships mentioned. Larken appeared in one of these, titled "''Kizbon's Box''" which gave no information as to what era it was set in.
